prompt:
You are an expert digital design engineer writing synthesizable Verilog.
Implement the module 'TopModule' according to the following specification.
Output ONLY complete, synthesizable Verilog code enclosed in a ```verilog ... ``` block.
Do not include testbenches or explanations.

SPECIFICATION:

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - output q (4 bits)

The module should implement a decade counter that counts 1 through 10,
inclusive. Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge
of the clock. The reset input is active high synchronous, and should
reset the counter to 1.
raw_response:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       reset,
    output reg  [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'd1;
        end else if (q >= 4'd10) begin
            q <= 4'd1;
        end else begin
            q <= q + 4'd1;
        end
    end

endmodule
```
